title: flybot/01/cmd/motor
description: Wheel command from the brain, QoS 0, not retained, one per brain tick (20 Hz), obeyed only in auto mode. The brain publishes nothing here while stale, paused or asleep. cmd/manual has its own schema (cmd-manual). Contract section 3.4.

l.description: Left wheel, -1.0 full reverse to +1.0 full forward (2 dp).

r.description: Right wheel, -1.0 full reverse to +1.0 full forward (2 dp).

rs.description: seq of the newest sensors message the brain used.
